description: Converge WorkflowRun reads on the Run CLI surface and retire the duplicate Issue workflow subtree.

tasks.title: Unify WorkflowRun CLI reads
tasks.description: Add `mo run timeline` beside the existing Run reads, using the established Run ID or `--issue` target resolver and the WorkflowRun detail response. Remove the `mo issue workflow` command subtree, update CLI help and the CLI reference, and retain Issue Workflow Profile selection only on create/edit. Extend the CLI contract tests for timeline reads, retired-command rejection, and command discovery.
acceptanceCriteria: `mo run timeline` accepts exactly one Run ID or `--issue <number>` and displays the selected Run's existing timeline data.
A missing or ambiguous Run target returns a local usage failure without HTTP requests, and an Issue without a bound Run returns the established actionable failure.
`mo issue workflow`, `mo issue workflow status`, and `mo issue workflow timeline` are unknown commands with no compatibility alias or HTTP request.

`mo run --help` and `docs/cli-reference.md` list timeline under Run reads; Issue help and documentation do not expose an Issue workflow read subarea; Workflow Profile options remain discoverable on issue create/edit.
Focused CLI tests cover Run-ID and Issue timeline targets, target validation, retired command rejection, and group-help/documentation contracts.
tasks.output: Updated CLI command tree, Run timeline read, CLI reference, and CLI contract tests.
tasks.notes: Reuse RunCommands target resolution and the existing WorkflowRun detail DTO. Do not add server routes, change workflow state behavior, or retain aliases for retired Issue commands.
